brand.name: RabtaaAI
brand.tagline: Report a problem. We'll find who can fix it.
brand.subtext: Send us a photo, voice note, or description. Our AI identifies the problem, finds the responsible authority, and prepares your complaint.
brand.hint: You don't need to know which department is responsible.

report.title: Report a Civic Problem
report.photo_drop: Drag & drop an image, or click to browse
report.exif_not_found: Location information was not found in this photo.
report.voice_instruction: Speak in Urdu, English, or Roman Urdu. Mention the problem and where it is located.
report.text_placeholder: e.g., North Nazimabad Block H mein 4 din se kachra nahi uthaya gaya / Gutter overflow on Shahrah-e-Faisal...
report.location_fail: We couldn't access your location. You can choose the issue location on the map.

result.duplicate_desc: residents have reported a similar problem.
result.no_email_warning: An email contact has not been configured for this authority yet.
result.sent_desc: Your complaint has been sent to the responsible authority.

dashboard.title: My Complaints
dashboard.subtitle: Track your civic reports submitted across Karachi
dashboard.search_placeholder: Search by category, area, authority, or ID...
dashboard.empty_desc: Report your first civic issue and we'll help route it to the right authority.

errors.generic: We're having trouble analyzing this report right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.location_denied: We couldn't access your location. Please allow location access or choose the issue location on the map.
errors.image_error: We couldn't process this image. Please try another clear photo.
errors.audio_error: We couldn't understand the recording. Please try recording again in a quiet place.
errors.network: Your internet connection appears to be unavailable. Please check your connection and try again.
